observations.behavior: Snapshot hashes for several taxonomic filter configurations are updated.
observations.posthog_connection: These snapshots represent cached UI states or query results used by PostHog's frontend; updating them does not change underlying behavior.

observations.behavior: A conditional check using a feature flag is removed from PinnedTaxonomicFilter seeding logic.
observations.posthog_connection: This removes dependency on TAXONOMIC_FILTER_DEFAULT_PINS, potentially changing how pinned filters behave when the flag is absent.

observations.behavior: The kea connection to featureFlagLogic and its values is removed from PinnedTaxonomicFilterPinnedPropertiesLogic.
observations.posthog_connection: Decouples this component from global feature flags, possibly removing opt-in gating for default pins functionality.

observations.limitations: Only snapshot hash changes do not demonstrate behavioral benefit; no tests remain after removal of related checks; no implementation changes shown that could preserve or improve existing behavior. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction demonstrated.

review.limitations: Only snapshot hash changes do not demonstrate behavioral benefit; no tests remain after removal of related checks; no implementation changes shown that could preserve or improve existing behavior. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction demonstrated.
review.reason: Changes consist mainly of snapshot updates and removal of optional feature-flag-dependent initialization without broader capability improvement or systemic reliability enhancement.
review.posthog_relevance: Snapshot hashes are metadata; their update alone does not establish user benefit. The removal of the pin-seeding guard may affect users relying on those defaults but lacks evidence of improved correctness or recovery.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on visible hunks; complete absence of replacement implementation or test preservation makes tier elevation impossible.
